nodes.description: Address with authority to change the admin of the delegator (admin).
Governance address allowed to change implementation and governance (governance).
Active implementation (logic) contract address that receives all delegatecalls (implementation).
ERC20-style token name string stored in proxy storage (name).
ERC20-style token symbol string stored in proxy storage (symbol).
Token decimals constant (decimals = 18).
Total token supply held in proxy storage (totalSupply).
Mapping of holder balances held in proxy storage (balanceOf).
Nested allowance mapping held in proxy storage (allowance).
Lock period constant for TokenBar (lockPeriod = 604800).
Address of the SHD token used by the implementation (SHDToken).
Mapping of token pairs to router addresses (routerMap).
Address of the market regulator (marketRegulator).
Address of the wrapped ether token (weth).
Mapping of addresses to lock deadlines (lockDeadline).
TokenBarDelegator constructor: sets admin to msg.sender, stores governance, sets implementation and calls initialize via delegateTo.
_setImplementation(address) public: governance-only function that overwrites the implementation address.
_setAdmin(address) public: admin-only function that overwrites the admin address.
_setGovernance(address) public: governance-only function that overwrites the governance address.
delegateTo(address,bytes) internal: performs an arbitrary delegatecall to callee with data and reverts on failure.
receive() external payable: accepts plain ether transfers.
fallback() external payable: delegatecalls the implementation with msg.data and returns/reverts the raw returndata.
msg.sender used for authorization checks in the constructor and setter functions.
callee.delegatecall(data) executed inside delegateTo with an arbitrary callee and calldata.
implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) executed inside fallback using attacker-supplied calldata.
Constructor parameter _governance, stored into the governance state variable.
Constructor parameter _SHDToken, ABI-encoded into the initialize call.
Constructor parameter _marketRegulator, ABI-encoded into the initialize call.
Constructor parameter _weth, ABI-encoded into the initialize call.
Constructor parameter implementation_ used for _setImplementation and delegateTo.
Function parameter implementation_ of _setImplementation, written into implementation.
Function parameter newAdmin of _setAdmin, written into admin.
Function parameter newGovernance of _setGovernance, written into governance.
Function parameter callee of delegateTo, the target of the delegatecall.
Function parameter data of delegateTo, the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Local oldImplementation capturing the previous implementation before overwrite.
Local oldAdmin capturing the previous admin before overwrite.
Local oldGovernance capturing the previous governance before overwrite.
Local success flag returned by the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
Local returnData bytes returned by the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
Local success flag returned by the delegatecall inside fallback.
Local free_mem_ptr used to copy returndata in the fallback assembly block.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, so the deployer becomes the privileged admin.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender == governance before changing the implementation.
_setAdmin requires msg.sender == admin before changing the admin.
_setGovernance requires msg.sender == governance before changing governance.
Constructor writes the _governance parameter into the governance state variable.
Constructor passes implementation_ into _setImplementation which stores it as the implementation.
_setImplementation writes its implementation_ parameter into the implementation state variable.
_setAdmin writes newAdmin into the admin state variable.
_setGovernance writes newGovernance into the governance state variable.
_setImplementation stores the new logic address in implementation.
oldImplementation local captures the previous value of implementation.
oldAdmin local captures the previous value of admin.
oldGovernance local captures the previous value of governance.
Constructor calls _setImplementation; the governance check passes because governance was set just before.
Constructor calls delegateTo to run initialize on the implementation contract.
Constructor forwards implementation_ as the callee of delegateTo.
_SHDToken is ABI-encoded and forwarded through delegateTo to the implementation.
_marketRegulator is ABI-encoded and forwarded through delegateTo to the implementation.
_weth is ABI-encoded and forwarded through delegateTo to the implementation.
delegateTo executes callee.delegatecall(data), the unsafe operation.
The callee parameter is an arbitrary address supplied to the delegatecall target.
The data parameter is arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
success local receives the boolean result of the delegatecall.
returnData local receives the raw bytes returned by the delegatecall.
fallback performs implementation.delegatecall(msg.data), the unsafe operation.
fallback forwards all calls to the implementation state variable, which is governance-controlled.
success local receives the boolean result of the fallback delegatecall.
free_mem_ptr is used to copy returndata produced by the fallback delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: The _governance parameter has no independent behaviour outside the constructor; it is simply stored into governance.
_SHDToken is only used to build the initialize calldata inside the constructor.
_marketRegulator is only used to build the initialize calldata inside the constructor.
_weth is only used to build the initialize calldata inside the constructor.
implementation_ from the constructor is consumed by _setImplementation and holds no separate semantics.
implementation_ is the value written into the implementation state variable by _setImplementation.
newAdmin is the sole input of _setAdmin and is written directly into admin.
newGovernance is the sole input of _setGovernance and is written directly into governance.
callee is the delegatecall target and determines the unsafe operation executed by delegateTo.
data is the raw calldata executed by the delegatecall in delegateTo.
oldImplementation exists only to emit the NewImplementation event inside _setImplementation.
oldAdmin exists only to emit the NewAdmin event inside _setAdmin.
oldGovernance exists only to emit the NewGovernance event inside _setGovernance.
success only holds the delegatecall status used by the assembly revert check.
returnData only holds the delegatecall output returned by delegateTo.
success in fallback only holds the delegatecall status consumed by the assembly switch.
free_mem_ptr is a scratch memory pointer local to the fallback returndatacopy logic.
